name: @aburi/e2e-integration
description: End-to-end tests exercising @aburi/cli against fixtures/nestjs-billing. Runs runInit / runScan / runDiff (no subprocess spawn — the CLI is imported directly) and drives the three PR scenarios in design/implementation-plan.md §4 WI-16 with in-tree fixture mutations. Snapshots are structural (component counts, diff status distribution, gate outcome) rather than byte-exact — a full IR snapshot would rot on every plugin tweak.
